name: Relentless
description: +1 to Class Resource recharge rolls (+2 at Level 5).

name: Iron Will
description: Death rolls use 3d10 (choose best 2); Second Wind HP is doubled.

name: Weapon Bond
description: +1 damage with chosen weapon class; stackable and repeatable for other competencies.

name: Sprinter
description: Once per Full Rest: Movement action covers 2 range bands, immune to Provoked Attacks that round.

name: Hardy
description: Max HP always increased by Level + 5.

name: Exploiter
description: Successful Provoked Attacks deal extra HL damage.

name: Guardian's Vow
description: No Provoked Attacks when stabilizing allies; stabilize rolls can Recharge; success grants Benefit on next action.

name: Born Fighter
description: Double 10s grant both Massive Hit and Adrenaline Rush (instead of choosing).

name: Swift Reaction
description: Benefit + HL bonus on all Speed checks.

name: Efficient
description: Once per Full Rest: reduce next power's Class Resource cost by 2.

name: Toxin Resistance
description: Improved resilience against Poison and Disease effects.
